allOf.title: Snapshot
allOf.description: Snapshot provides information about a storage volume snapshot.

startTime.description: The time (epoch) at which the request to create the snapshot was submitted.

volumeID.description: The ID of the volume to which the snapshot belongs.

volumeSize.description: The size of the volume to which the snapshot belongs.

encrypted.description: A flag indicating whether or not the snapshot is encrypted.

allOf.description: Opts are additional properties that can be defined for POST requests.

allOf.title: VolumeAttachment
allOf.description: VolumeAttachment provides information about an object attached to a storage volume.

deviceName.description: The name of the device on to which the volume is mounted.

mountPoint.description: The file system path to which the volume is mounted.

volumeID.description: The ID of the volume to which the attachment belongs.

name.description: Ignore is a flag that indicates whether the client logic should invoke the GetNextAvailableDeviceName function prior to submitting an AttachVolume request to the server.

type.description: Type is the type of storage the driver provides: block, nas, object.

allOf.title: Volume
allOf.description: Volume provides information about a storage volume.

availabilityZone.description: The zone for which the volume is available.

attachmentState.description: Indicates the volume's attachment state - 0=none,1=unknown,2=attached,3=available,4=unavailable. A volume is marked as attached if attached to the instance specified in the requesting API call. A volume that is attached but not to the requesting instance is marked as unavailable.

networkName.description: The name of the network on which the volume resides.

encrypted.description: A flag indicating whether or not the volume is encrypted.

id.description: ID is a piece of information that uniquely identifies the volume on the storage platform to which the volume belongs. A volume ID is not guaranteed to be unique across multiple, configured services.

allOf.title: Instance
allOf.description: Instance is additional information about a host, generated using the InstanceID.

providerName.description: The name of the provider that owns the object.

region.description: The region from which the object originates.

startTime.description: The time stamp (epoch) when the task started running.

queueTime.description: The time stamp (epoch) when the task was created.

completeTime.description: The time stamp (epoch) when the task was completed.

error.description: If the operation returned an error, this is it.

user.description: The name of the user that created the task.

allOf.description: Fields are additional properties that can be defined for this type.

allOf.title: InstanceID
allOf.description: InstanceID identifies a host to a remote storage platform.

formatted.description: A flag indicating whether or not the instance ID has been formatted by an instance inspection.

service.description: The name of the service for which the instance ID is valid.

driver.description: The name of the driver that created the instance ID.

metadata.description: Extra information about the instance ID.

ignore.description: Ignore is a flag that indicates whether the client logic should invoke the GetNextAvailableDeviceName function prior to submitting an AttachVolume request to the server.

prefix.description: Prefix is the first part of a device path's value after the "/dev/" portion. For example, the prefix in "/dev/xvda" is "xvd".

pattern.description: Pattern is the regex to match the part of a device path after the prefix.

md5checksum.description: The file's MD5 checksum. This can be used to determine if a local copy of the executor needs to be updated.

size.description: The size of the executor, in bytes.

lastModified.description: The time the executor was last modified as an epoch.
